name: bicg_v4_1
description: `bicg_v4` for N beyond one bank, in strips of R·W columns outermost: q's half `matvec/matvec_v9`, each row's sum carried to the next strip through L1 as the tree's own seed, 0 on the first (D192); s's half `matvec/matvec_v8`, its bank one strip deep; A still read once (`fork_read`, D189). Two strips at 64 × 64, W = 4, R = 8.
